name: @lanka-playgrounds/react-shared
description: Atlas for React: the half that every React host shares and no other ecosystem can use — hooks over the shared ViewModels, and the components a DOM host renders.
//exports: Two entries, and the split is not cosmetic. The root is DOM-free and is what the device application imports; `./dom` holds JSX over intrinsic elements, which does not typecheck under React Native's types. One barrel would have made every DOM component part of the device application's program.
